vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Select, organize and look after something
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: ex.: The Miraikan curates three or more special interactive exhibitions each year.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: She curated a collection of photographs for the gallery.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Describes how someone feels emotionally at a particular time.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She is in a good mood today.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex: Music always improves my mood.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Relaxed and not worried or stressed.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I like to stay chilled out on weekends.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Somewhat; to a moderate degree, but not completely.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I am somewhat tired after work.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Not requiring much effort; simple to do or understand.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It is easy to maneuver this small car.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To a fairly large degree; moderately.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My routine is fairly simple.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Used to introduce a preference or offer an alternative.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Would you rather have tea or coffee?

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To behave toward someone in a particular way; also, a special event or occasion.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Treat others with respect.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.:You worked hard this week. Treat yourself to a nice dinner!

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The act of accepting something or someone; approval or agreement.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Her acceptance of the job offer made her very happy.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To make someone feel unhappy, anxious, or worried; a feeling of emotional disturbance.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She was upset when she heard the bad news.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Stop complaining and help me clean the kitchen.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To throw something forcefully through the air.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The angry teacher threw the pen across the room.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To make a great effort to do something difficult or to fight against a problem.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I struggle with English grammar, but I keep practicing.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The physical or mental energy needed to do something; hard work.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Learning English takes time and effort.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Having a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular field.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She is a leading expert in technology.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Despite the fact that; used to introduce a contrast.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Although it was raining, they went for a walk.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A piece of writing on a particular subject, usually presenting ideas or arguments.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I have to write an essay about climate change.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Feeling confident and certain about something; not worried or doubtful.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I am so relieved to hear that you are safe.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Extremely attractive, charming, or fascinating.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She has a captivating smile that everyone notices.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Up to a particular time or event; until that moment. Till and until have the same meaning. You can use either one in this sentence
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I will stay here till tomorrow.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex. I will study English till 8 PM

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Happening very quickly and unexpectedly.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Suddenly, the lights went out.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Left home or went somewhere. Something stopped working or functioning.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The lights went out during the storm
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: They went out together last night

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: For that reason; as a result.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It was raining; therefore, we stayed at home.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Filled with many people or things close together.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The subway is always crowded during rush hour.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Extremely impressive, beautiful, or surprising; inspiring wonder.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The night sky was a wondrous sight.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To express strong approval or admiration for someone or something.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The teacher praised the student for her excellent work.

vocabulary.title: What is the definition of this word in the sentence?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Emphasizing something. Describing a type of thing
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It was such a beautiful day!
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I love such stories

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Certainly; without doubt.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I will definitely finish my homework today.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: She is definitely the right person for the job.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Tasting very good; delicious.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: This cake is really yummy.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: We had a yummy lunch at the new restaurant.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Causing something to stop completely or come to a sudden end.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The heavy snow brought traffic to a halt.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: A power failure brought the concert to a halt.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To allow yourself to enjoy something pleasurable, often more than usual.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I like to indulge in a large piece of chocolate cake.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: She decided to indulge herself with a relaxing bath.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To not have enough of something; to be missing something.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Some plants lack enough water in the summer.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The report lacks important information.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Maybe; possibly.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Perhaps you could consider hiring more staff.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: Perhaps we should leave a little earlier.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A goal or purpose; what someone hopes to achieve.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My aim is to speak English more confidently.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The aim of this lesson is to improve your vocabulary.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Right or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: These shoes are suitable for walking.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: This movie is suitable for children.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: (Adjective) Complete and careful, with attention to every detail.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Please do a thorough check before you submit the form.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The doctor gave me a thorough examination.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Almost; not quite.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I have nearly finished my book.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: We nearly missed the bus.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: (Verb) To make certain that something happens or is true.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Please ensure that the door is locked.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: This checklist helps ensure that nothing is forgotten.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Used to say that something bad or disappointing happened.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Unfortunately, I missed the train.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: Unfortunately, the store was closed.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: An informal word for a roommate; someone you share a room or home with.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My roomie and I cook dinner together.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I met my new roomie yesterday.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: But; used to introduce a contrast.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The weather was awful. However, we decided to walk by the pool.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I was tired; however, I continued studying.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Not expected or predicted; unexpected.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: We had to come back from our vacation early because of an unforeseen emergency.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: An unforeseen problem delayed the project.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The woman who is married to someone's father but is not their biological mother.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My stepmother makes delicious soup.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: He visited his stepmother on Sunday.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Deep sadness, especially after someone has died.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She needed time to cope with her grief.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: His friends supported him during his grief.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To feel or express deep sadness about a loss.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: It is natural to grieve over the loss of someone you love.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: He continued to grieve over his friend's death.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Honestly; speaking openly and directly.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Frankly, I don't think that movie was very good.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: Frankly, I need more time to make a decision.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A little; by a small amount or degree.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I'm slightly tired, but I will keep studying.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The second exercise is slightly harder.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: (Adjective) Comfortable, warm, and pleasant.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: This is a cozy room to read in.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: We spent a cozy evening at home.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To relax and enjoy the warmth of the sun.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I like to bask in the sunshine on warm days.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The cat basked in the sunshine by the window.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The activity of taking a long walk in the countryside or mountains.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: We went hiking in the mountains last weekend.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: Hiking is a great way to enjoy nature.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A person who has expert knowledge of and appreciates a subject, especially art, food, or drink.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: He is a connoisseur of fine art.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: As a coffee connoisseur, she can recognize different flavors.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The ability to make good decisions using knowledge and experience.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: My grandmother has a lot of wisdom.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: He shared some words of wisdom with the students.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To wish you had given yourself permission to explore without a strict plan.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText: I wish I had allowed myself to get lost
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I wish I had allowed myself to get lost in the city.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I wish I had allowed myself to explore the old streets.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To stop trying to manage or control everything around you.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Sometimes, you need to let go of control and enjoy the moment.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I am learning to let go of control and trust the process.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A way to say that you would prefer one thing over another.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: I'd rather stay home and read tonight.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: I'd rather walk than take the bus.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To spend time relaxing or socializing with someone, usually casually.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Do you want to hang out at my house this weekend?
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: We usually hang out after class.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: The newest or most recent.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The people of Tokyo have the latest cars.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: Have you seen the latest news?

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: Very modern and advanced; using the newest ideas or technology.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: Japan has cutting-edge technology in people's daily lives.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The company uses cutting-edge technology.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A street full of activity, people, and movement.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The city has bustling streets filled with the newest technology.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: We walked along a bustling street full of shops and cafés.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A person who is exceptionally intelligent or shows extraordinary ability.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She is a genius at solving difficult problems.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: The young genius invented a useful app.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: A person who supports an activity, organization, or place, often with money; also a customer of a business.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The museum's patron donated money for a new exhibition.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: He is a regular patron of that café.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: To select, organize, and look after items or content, especially for a collection or exhibition.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: The curator curates two special exhibitions each year.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: She curated a collection of photographs for the gallery.

vocabulary.title: What is the meaning of this word or expression?
vocabulary.titleAnswer: (Verb) To deal successfully with a difficult situation, problem, or emotion.
vocabulary.auxiliaryText2: Ex.: She learned to cope with stress at work.
vocabulary.auxiliaryTextAnswer: Ex.: He finds it difficult to cope with change.
